skill.name: videocut
skill.description: Cuts spoken videos from confirmed timestamp deletion tasks using FFmpeg, re-transcription, and subtitle generation.
skill.summary: Execute timestamp-based spoken-video cuts and generate subtitles after review.
skill.author: Ceeon

security_audit.summary: The skill is a legitimate spoken-video editing workflow, but it intentionally invokes FFmpeg and FunASR and writes temporary media files. Most static backtick and entropy hits are markdown false positives; confirmed concerns are external command execution, predictable temporary paths, hidden model cache writes, and out-of-scope maintenance instructions.

remediation.issue: FFmpeg and transcription commands run on local media files.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before command execution and validate input and output paths stay inside the working project.
Use a secure temporary directory or unique temporary filenames, then clean only files created by the current run.

remediation.issue: The skill includes comments that point to ../README.md and /CLAUDE.md.
remediation.suggestion: Remove hidden maintenance instructions that direct agents to edit files outside the skill package.

remediation.issue: FunASR may download large models into ~/.cache/modelscope.
remediation.suggestion: Document the download clearly and ask users before installing models or writing to a hidden home cache.

content.user_title: Clean Spoken Videos With Timestamp Cuts
content.value_statement: Spoken videos often contain mistakes, filler words, and long silences. This skill applies confirmed timestamp edits with FFmpeg and checks the result with transcription.
actual_capabilities: Reads confirmed deletion tasks from a timestamp-based review list.
Builds an FFmpeg filter workflow for keeping approved video segments.
Re-transcribes edited video with FunASR to verify remaining speech issues.
Repeats review and editing steps until no marked mistakes remain.
Generates SRT subtitle files for the edited video.
limitations: Requires FFmpeg and compatible local media files.
Depends on accurate timestamp data from the review step.
FunASR model downloads can be large on first use.
Human review is still needed before deleting speech segments.

use_cases.title: Edit Creator Talking Videos
use_cases.description: Remove confirmed mistakes, filler words, and long pauses from recorded spoken videos.

use_cases.title: Prepare Course Clips
use_cases.description: Apply precise timestamp cuts to lecture recordings before publishing learning material.

use_cases.title: Clean Internal Briefings
use_cases.description: Turn rough meeting or briefing recordings into cleaner clips with subtitles.

prompt_templates.title: Run Confirmed Cuts
prompt_templates.prompt: Use videocut to execute the confirmed deletion tasks for this video. Keep unchecked items and generate the edited video.

prompt_templates.title: Cut And Verify Speech
prompt_templates.prompt: Cut the checked timestamp ranges, re-transcribe the edited file, and report whether any speech mistakes remain.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Selected Silences
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute all checked cuts except silence items 3 and 5. Keep those pauses, then create subtitles for the final version.

prompt_templates.title: Iterate Until Clean
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the current deletion list, create a new version, re-run transcription review, and continue only with confirmed new cuts.

output_examples.input: A confirmed task list marks three spoken mistakes and two long silences for deletion.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a new edited video version, a verification transcript, and an SRT subtitle file.

output_examples.input: The user asks to keep two silence items while deleting all other checked ranges.
output_examples.output: The final cut preserves the requested pauses and removes only the approved timestamp ranges.

output_examples.input: A review pass finds one remaining filler word after the first cut.
output_examples.output: The workflow creates a new deletion task and repeats editing after user confirmation.

best_practices: Confirm every deletion range before running FFmpeg.
Use timestamp ranges instead of searching transcript text.
Review the edited transcript before publishing the final video.
anti_patterns: Do not delete unchecked tasks from the review list.
Do not search text again when precise timestamps already exist.
Do not run media commands on untrusted paths without user confirmation.

faq.question: What does this skill need before editing?
faq.answer: It needs an original video and a confirmed timestamp deletion list from the review workflow.

faq.question: Does it create subtitles?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow generates an SRT subtitle file after the edited video passes review.

faq.question: Can it decide deletions automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill is designed to execute confirmed deletion tasks, not approve removals alone.

faq.question: Which tools does it use?
faq.answer: It uses FFmpeg for cutting and FunASR for transcription and timestamp verification.

faq.question: Why are timestamps important?
faq.answer: Timestamps prevent accidental deletion caused by repeated words or transcript search errors.

faq.question: Is there a first-run setup cost?
faq.answer: Yes. FunASR may download large speech models before transcription works locally.
